topic: Chennai monsoon eye care: rain water, hand hygiene, don't share towels

youtube.title: Rainy days, red eyes? 3 monsoon eye rules ☔ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Eye infections rise in the monsoon. 3 simple rules to protect your family.
மழைக்காலத்தில் கண் தொற்றிலிருந்து குடும்பத்தை காக்க 3 வழிகள்.

• Dirty rainwater, damp hands and crowded places help eye germs spread in the monsoon.
• Rule 1: wash hands with soap and water before touching your eyes.
• Rule 2: own towel, pillow and handkerchief for everyone; never share.
• Rule 3: keep rainwater out of your eyes; if it splashes in, rinse with clean water only.
• Eye flu spreads mostly through hands and shared things, not by looking at someone.
• See an eye specialist for pain, light sensitivity, blurred vision, or if it's not better in a few days.
• Don't use leftover or someone else's eye drops. General education only.

gmb.text:
Monsoon eye care for the family. During the rains, dirty rainwater, damp hands and crowded places help eye germs spread, so eye infections rise.

Three simple rules: wash hands with soap and water before touching your eyes; give everyone their own towel, pillow and handkerchief; and keep rainwater out of your eyes, rinsing with clean water only if it splashes in. Eye flu spreads mostly through hands and shared things.

See an eye specialist if there is pain, light sensitivity, blurred vision, or if it isn't better in a few days. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
